description: Comptage multimodal (Vélo, Trottinette, 2RM, VL, PL, Autobus-car) - Comptages is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Jeu de données des comptages multimodaux horaires par mode de déplacement issus de capteurs thermiques. La Ville de Paris collecte des données de comptages de véhicules par: Modes de déplacements (Trottinettes, Trottinettes + Vélos (lorsque la distinction entre ces 2 modes de déplacement n’est pas implémenté sur le capteur), Vélos, 2 roues motorisées, Véhicules légers ... Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are DVD, comptage vélo, comptage routier, IoT, trottinettes, vélo. The portal shows 12,992,862 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
